Ellie (customer): hey team — after we migrated some services to a new org key our embeddings suddenly changed dim from 3072 -> 1536. app breaks (indexer expects 3072). started ~10:03am UTC. no code changes on our side. any ideas?

Mia (support): sorry about that, totally understand. can you paste the request headers and a sample response (sanitized)? also tell us which API key you used (org-scoped vs project-scoped).

Ellie (customer): here's a redacted curl we used (we use a reverse proxy so headers are added by infra):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: org-ACQ-123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"some text to embed","model":"rwd-embed-large-v2"}'
```

and a snippet from our app logs (sanitized):

```json
{"request_id":"req_9abc","requested_model":"rwd-embed-large-v2","routing":{"org":"org-ACQ-123","project":null},"selected_model":"rwd-embed-small-v1","embedding_dim":1536}
```

Ellie (customer): if I remove the X-Redwood-Org header the request returns 3072 dims (large model). so seems like org header is causing the platform to pick a different model.

Kevin (engineer): thanks for the repro, that narrows it down. can you also paste any query params (we've seen `project=` sometimes sent in query) and the exact api key type? are you using a project-scoped key or an org-scoped key?

Ellie (customer): we use a shared org-scoped key injected by infra. we accidentally started sending `X-Redwood-Org` after a config change. query string had `?debug=true` only. no project param.

Mia (support): okay — preliminary hypothesis: org header is taking precedence over project selection and then routing to org default model profile (which is small). i'll escalate with exact repro. can you confirm the team id that should get the large model and the project id (if any)?

Ellie (customer): target project is proj-indexer-77, team expects rwd-embed-large-v2 default. we didn't realize the reverse proxy would inject org header.

Sanjay (eng-ml): quick tech note: model selection pipeline should prioritize explicit project-scoped settings (body param or project header) then API key binding, then org defaults. looks like a regression where `X-Redwood-Org` was treated as an override early in routing. i can reproduce locally with a simple curl that sends both org header and project body omitted.

Sanjay (eng-ml): repro curl i used locally:

```bash
# reproduce wrong model selection
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_org_***" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: org-ACQ-123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello","model":"rwd-embed-large-v2"}' | jq .
```

# shows selected_model: rwd-embed-small-v1 in routing log (bug)

Sanjay (eng-ml): temp workarounds: 1) remove the injected `X-Redwood-Org` header and use the API key only (preferred), 2) use a project-scoped API key (sk_proj_...) so routing binds to project, or 3) include explicit `project` in body: `{..., "project":"proj-indexer-77"}` — all of these avoid the header precedence issue for now.

Mia (support): thanks Sanjay. Ellie — can you try the `project` body workaround? it'd be a quick smoke test. if that works we'll keep you on the workaround while eng patches.

Ellie (customer): adding "project":"proj-indexer-77" fixed it immediately — embeddings are back to 3072. thanks!

Kevin (engineer): created a ticket ENG-5821, minimal fix is to change header precedence so project-scope wins over org header for model selection. i've pushed a staging patch (branch: fix/header-precedence). running unit + routing e2e now.

ops-bot (system): deployment queued for staging: fix/header-precedence by kevin — build 2026.03.15-125 (CI: passed unit tests).

Kevin (engineer): ETA for prod roll is ~4h after regression tests if staging looks green. will post updates here.

Mia (support): i'll mark this as escalated and keep the customer updated; follow-up: doc update to note header interactions + recommend project-scoped keys for critical services.

Ellie (customer): appreciate the fast turnaround. we'll switch infra to stop injecting org header and rotate keys to project-scope. thank you! :raised_hands:

Mia (support): great — closing loop once prod deploys. if anything changes DM me or reopen this thread. :thumbsup:
